notes.title: Version 0.2.2 Patch Notes and V0.3 Important Update Preview
notes.content:
Version 0.2.2 Game Content Updates:

- Balanced the data affected by policies.
- Fixed an issue where policies would not load correctly under specific conditions.

Since the release of Versions 0.1 to 0.2, we've gathered valuable feedback through interviews, comments, and observing playthroughs on platforms like YouTube and Bilibili. Based on these, we’ve made significant changes to the game. The core elements of these changes will be introduced in Version 0.3. We sincerely thank all the governors for your continued support!

Preview of Version 0.3 Updates:

- The new version will feature the map as the primary interface.
- Civil prestige, technology, and development paths will be introduced.
- The gameplay will be enhanced, allowing players to take more diverse actions, such as controlling the spread of news or building public facilities.
- The economic mechanics will be enriched, with a notable distinction between the government and personal financial accounts, giving players more freedom in financial decisions.
- A new "Fieldwork Research" feature will be added, enabling players to interact with NPCs, trade, give or receive items.
- Character stories will progress more reasonably and organically.
- A new batch of content will be introduced, including but not limited to new characters, news, and policies.
- The "Reject Policy" action will come with more feedback in the game.
- The game’s storyline will undergo significant enhancements.

Other Planned Updates (release version to be decided):

- The version for Mac users.
- Resolution support, including widescreen and windowed mode.

notes.title: Version 0.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Gameplay Updates:
- New Policies: More policies have been added for players to choose from. Policies within levels will now be randomly selected instead of being fixed combinations.
- New Resident: "Oscar Seaford" has been introduced.
- New Storylines: Added new storylines for residents.
- New News Events: Included more news events.
- Bug Fixes: Fixed issues where some stories were not triggering correctly.

User Interface Updates:
- Text Content: Polished the text content for policies, news, and residents' storylines.
- Language Fix: Resolved an issue in the Chinese version where news publishers in the archive were displayed only in English.
- Font Adjustment: Adjusted the text font in the archive.
- Social Media Links: Added social media link buttons for our studio in the start menu.
- Loading Animation: Added a loading animation when loading levels.
- Text Modifications: Modified some textual information content.

Planned Minor Updates:
- macOS Version: Currently being notarized and may be released soon.
- Storyline Optimization: Planning to optimize the internal logic of character storylines to make them more organic and varied.
